basic_details.job_title: CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Junior Research Fellow, Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF)

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated through e-mail / NAL website

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 32 years for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) as on the last date of receipt of application.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior research fellow (srf): First class MSc in Physics/Material Science/Electronics with minimum 2 years of research experience, One publication in a SCI Journal and should have completed at least two years of post-MSc. research experience; OR M.Tech in Nanotechnology / electronics with at least 60% marks. Preference will be given to NET/GATE qualified candidates. | junior research fellow (jrf): First class MSc. Physics/Material Science/Chemistry. Applicants should have CSIR UGC NET (Lectureship qualification also eligible) or a valid GATE score/qualification.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 37,000/- pm + HRA (JRF) and Rs. 42,000/- pm + HRA (SRF)
salary_details.details: No additional grants or salary will be paid apart from the fellowship amount. On account of official visits to other places, laboratories, or institutes, candidates will be entitled to reimbursement under the project as per rules of CSIR/CSIR-NAL.

selection_process: The selection process involves the screening and shortlisting of applications based on information furnished in the offline application form
followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates through email.
how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official website www.nal.res.in.
Fill out the application form completely in your own handwriting or neatly typed.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the designated space of the application form.

Enclose self-attested copies of matriculation (10th) certificate as proof of date of birth, 12th standard certificate, degree and above certificates, experience certificates, and community or caste certificate if applicable.
Place the filled application form and all enclosures inside a sealed cover.
Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW / SENIOR RESEARCH FELLOW. Advt. No.14/2026".
Send the sealed cover by post to The Sr. Controller of Administration, National Aerospace Laboratories, P.B.No.1779, HAL Airport Road, Kodihalli, Bengaluru – 560 017 on or before 18 October 2026.
important_instructions: These positions are open only to Indian Nationals and Overseas citizens of India. The engagement is for a temporary duration of two years, with upgradation to SRF from the third year based on performance. Furnishing of wrong or false information will lead to disqualification and CSIR-NAL will not be responsible for consequences. Canvassing in any form or bringing in political or other influence will be treated as a disqualification. Candidates are advised to work for the project for a minimum duration of one year after appointment. If a candidate wishes to leave the job, prior information of a minimum of 1 month is required. No transport allowance will be paid for attending the interview. Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026 is an advertisement (No. 14/2026) issued by CSIR National Aerospace Laboratories to recruit one Junior Research Fellow and one Senior Research Fellow on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies notified under this recruitment, comprising 1 post for Junior Research Fellow and 1 post for Senior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled offline application forms is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post must possess a First class MSc in Physics, Material Science, or Chemistry, along with CSIR UGC NET (Lectureship qualification also eligible) or a valid GATE score/qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR NAL Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 32 years as on the last date of receipt of application, with relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PWD candidates as per CSIR/GoI guidelines.
